body:
### Summary

When uv fetches a Git dependency into its cache database, `git fetch` can start Git's automatic maintenance in the background (`git maintenance run --auto --detach`). Since Git 2.54 the default maintenance strategy is geometric repacking, which writes a multi-pack-index and deletes the packs it replaced. uv then immediately runs `git clone --local` (or `--no-hardlinks` after a failed `--local` attempt) from that same database into a checkout. The clone and the detached maintenance can overlap, and the clone can fail with `No such file or directory` for a pack or for `multi-pack-index.lock`.

We hit this twice in CI (GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runners, uv 0.13.4 via `astral-sh/setup-uv`, Git 2.55.0) while installing a project twice in one job from a local `git+file://` URL, so the second install fetched into the existing cache database:

```text
error: Git operation failed
  cause: process didn't exit successfully: `/usr/bin/git clone --no-hardlinks /home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache/git-v1/db/18a968a57034ee11 /home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache/git-v1/checkouts/18a968a57034ee11/edec79c` (exit status: 128)
         fatal: failed to copy file to '/home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache/git-v1/checkouts/18a968a57034ee11/edec79c/.git/objects/pack/pack-e8ff1962efa64c3d6618ca63f5bed9a75de43537.pack': No such file or directory
```

```text
error: Git operation failed
  cause: process didn't exit successfully: `/usr/bin/git clone --no-hardlinks /home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache/git-v1/db/18a968a57034ee11 /home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache/git-v1/checkouts/18a968a57034ee11/96152b7` (exit status: 128)
         fatal: failed to copy file to '/home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache/git-v1/checkouts/18a968a57034ee11/96152b7/.git/objects/pack/multi-pack-index.lock': No such file or directory
```

### What we traced

We could not reproduce the failure itself locally (81 traced and untraced installs all succeeded), so the link between these two CI failures and maintenance is inferred from the mechanism below rather than observed in a failing run.

With uv 0.13.4 and Git 2.55.0 (built from the official source), a second install from the same URL produced this Trace2 sequence (paths shortened):

```text
git fetch --force --update-head-ok file:///<source> +<sha>:refs/commit/<sha>
git maintenance run --auto --no-quiet --detach
git repack -d -l --cruft --cruft-expiration=2.weeks.ago --write-midx
git clone --local <uv-cache>/git-v1/db/<id> <uv-cache>/git-v1/checkouts/<id>/<rev>
git multi-pack-index write --no-progress --preferred-pack=pack-<hash>.pack ... --stdin-packs
```

A syscall trace of one install (with maintenance forced to run) shows the overlap directly: the clone linked a pack from the database, then about 37 ms later the detached repack unlinked that same pack, with `multi-pack-index.lock` created and renamed in between. In that sample the clone had already copied the file, so it succeeded; a slightly different interleaving gives the errors above.

Relevant upstream facts:

- Git 2.54 release notes: "git maintenance" starts using the "geometric" strategy by default.
- `maintenance.autoDetach` falls back to `gc.autoDetach` and defaults to true.
- The `git clone` documentation warns that a local clone "can race with concurrent modification to the source repository".
- In uv 0.13.4 and 0.13.5, `fetch_with_cli` in `crates/uv-git/src/git.rs` runs `git fetch --force --update-head-ok` without disabling automatic maintenance, and `clone_into` clones from the database right afterwards.

### Suggestion

Since uv owns the cache database and clones from it immediately, consider disabling automatic maintenance for uv's own fetches, for example `git fetch --no-auto-gc` (available since at least Git 2.23; a synonym of `--no-auto-maintenance` since Git 2.29), or `-c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0`. If periodic maintenance of the database is wanted, it could run explicitly while uv holds its cache lock.

Workaround we use in the meantime: run uv with `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`/`GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n`/`GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n` entries setting `maintenance.auto=false` and `gc.auto=0`. With that, the same sequence shows the fetches with no maintenance child.

### Versions

- uv 0.13.4 (CI); the relevant code is unchanged in 0.13.5
- Git 2.55.0 (CI and local reproduction of the overlap); Git 2.53.0 did not run the geometric repack by default
- Linux x86_64
title: Git dependency checkout can race with detached `git maintenance` started by uv's own fetch (Git 2.54+)
